chunks: If a man dies and leaves behind both his parents, then the mother has one-third and the father has two-thirds. If he leaves behind his parents and one brother or one sister, then the mother has one-third and the father has two-thirds. But if he leaves behind his parents and one brother and two sisters, or two brothers, or four sisters from the father's side or from the father's and mother's side, then the mother has one-sixth, and whatever remains belongs to the father.
Because of the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: “But if he has brothers,” meaning brothers from the father's side or from the father's and mother's side, “then for his mother is one-sixth.”

They only reduce the mother from one-third because they are among the dependents of the father and their maintenance is upon him; so they reduce the share, but they do not inherit. And whenever he leaves behind his parents and maternal brothers and sisters, no matter how many they are, they do not reduce the mother from one-third, nor do they inherit.

key_terms.إِخْوَةً وَأَخَوَاتٍ لِأُمٍّ: maternal siblings, who here neither reduce the mother's share nor inherit
key_terms.إِخْوَةٌ لِأَبٍ: siblings related through the father whose presence affects the mother's share
key_terms.حَجَبُوا الْأُمَّ: they reduced or blocked the mother from the larger share
key_terms.لِأَبٍ وَأُمٍّ: full siblings related through both father and mother

ai.seo_question: When do siblings reduce the mother's inheritance share from one-third to one-sixth in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This report sets out the inheritance shares of the parents when the deceased also leaves certain siblings. It explains that paternal or full siblings can reduce the mother's share from one-third to one-sixth, while maternal siblings do not reduce her share and do not inherit in this case.
